depiction.primary_object: small open laptop in bottom right corner
modifiers: two curved counter-clockwise arrows forming an incomplete loop
depiction.composition: circular sync arrows interrupted in the bottom-right quadrant by a miniature laptop

readings.meaning: sync laptop or desktop computer data
back up or restore laptop files
trade in or replace an old laptop

ambiguity: At small sizes the small laptop can look like a generic box, drawer, or hard drive enclosure next to sync arrows.
task_intents: sync files across laptops and devices
run operating system updates on laptop
set up automatic desktop cloud sync
migrate data to a replacement computer

reasoning: The icon combines a small laptop with two circular sync/refresh arrows, clearly signaling computer synchronization, OS updates, backups, or system resets. These are common personal and work maintenance tasks, though at very small sizes the miniature laptop could be mistaken for a generic rectangle or drive icon.
